summary: First full pass. Backend: 35 pytest cases, 28 passed (80%). All 6 in-scope tools work on valid input and produce correct output: merge order is right, split zip pages are right, remove-pages drops the right pages, organize order is right, jpg-to-pdf gives one page per image in the right order. Jobs and download endpoints work. Auth works (login with httpOnly cookie, /me, wrong password gives 401, logout). Unauthenticated calls to all /api/admin/* endpoints get 401. The failures are all in error handling: validation errors come back as HTTP 500 instead of 400. Compress levels have no effect. Frontend: all 25 routes load. Each page has a unique title, a meta description and a canonical URL. JSON-LD is on home, FAQ, tool pages and articles. All 6 tools ran end-to-end in the UI, including the download. No horizontal overflow at 390px. Mobile menu, contact form, admin login/dashboard/tabs/SEO save and logout all work. No broken internal links.

critical.issue: pdf.ProcessingError is raised in the endpoint body, outside run_tool's try/except, and nothing handles it. A non-PDF renamed to .pdf, a corrupted PDF, an encrypted PDF, a PDF over the 500-page limit, or a non-image sent to jpg-to-pdf all return HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error'. The UI then shows the generic 'Something went wrong'. Fix: add @app.exception_handler(pdf.ProcessingError) that returns 400 with {detail: str(e)}.

Page specs that are not numbers ('abc', '1-', 'x,y', 'a-b') raise ValueError from int(), which is caught as a generic Exception, so the response is 500 'An unexpected error occurred'. They should be 400 with a clear message. Wrap the parsing in _parse_pages, organize_pdf and split_pdf and raise ProcessingError.

Possible DoS (found in code review, not executed). A huge range like '1-999999999' fills a Python list with every page index before the bounds check runs. This can exhaust memory and kill the worker. Check the bounds before expanding the range.

Image recompression never runs. pdf_processing.py line 111 reads `doc.update_stream(...) if False else None`, which is a no-op. low, medium and high all produce byte-identical output (tested: 8.6MB to 4.1MB for every level, only from deflate/garbage). Scanned or photo-heavy PDFs will barely shrink, and the level selector does nothing. Replace the images, for example with page.replace_image(xref, stream=...). Also return the original if the output is larger.

minor.issue: A reversed range like '3-1' is silently ignored: 200 with no pages removed. Split rejects the same input correctly.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True. Starlette reflects any Origin (verified: evil.com gets ACAO plus credentials=true). Together with the SameSite=None cookie, any site can make credentialed calls to the admin endpoints. Set explicit origins.

get_remote_address uses the proxy/ingress IP (Firebase/Cloud Run/k8s). All users share one 20/min-per-tool bucket, so in production legitimate users will get 429s. Use X-Forwarded-For. The login lockout key has the same problem.
Hardcoded fallback ADMIN_PASSWORD 'admin123' and a default email. Remove the defaults. Seeding is idempotent and does not overwrite an existing admin (OK).
The whole upload is read into memory before the 50MB check, and there is no request-body size limit at the server or proxy level.
Validation failures (fake PDF and so on) happen before run_tool, so they are not counted as total or failed in tool_stats.

These are root-level backend routes. In preview, ingress sends them to the frontend, which returns text/html for the SPA. No /api alias exists, so they could not be verified through the public URL. They only work in production if firebase.json rewrites them to Cloud Run.
There is no delete endpoint, so the test contacts could not be removed (see seed_data_creation).

ui_bugs.issue: setError(oversize msg) is immediately followed by setError(''), so the '>50MB' error is never shown. The file is just dropped silently.
POPULAR_SLUGS shows pdf-to-word and rotate-pdf (out of scope) but leaves out the Phase-1 tools Remove PDF Pages and Organize PDF.

integration_issues.issue: SEO home title/description is saved and persists (verified). But no frontend page reads config.seo: the home <title> stayed the same after saving 'TEST_title'. The setting has no effect.
Because of the backend 500s, uploading a fake PDF shows 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' and a bad page spec shows 'An unexpected error occurred'. Users get no useful message.

issues: The SPA renders meta and JSON-LD client-side only. Non-JS crawlers get the home meta from index.html on every route. Consider prerendering (react-snap or similar) for Firebase static hosting.

deployment_review: firebase.json rewrites /api/**, /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt and /ads.txt to Cloud Run service 'mycrushpdf-api'. The app is therefore NOT zero-cost static hosting: it needs a Cloud Run backend (server-side PyMuPDF processing plus MongoDB). For a static-only setup, ship sitemap.xml, robots.txt and ads.txt as files in public/ (dist).
Firebase 'public': 'dist', but CRA/craco builds to 'build/' by default. Check the build output folder, otherwise the deploy will be empty.
legal_consistency: The 60-minute retention stated in legal.js, tools.js and the ToolRunner UI matches FILE_RETENTION_MINUTES=60. Downloads are refused after expiry (410). Physical deletion runs every 5 minutes, so files can live up to about 65 minutes. That slightly contradicts 'deleted within 60 minutes'. Either say 'about 1 hour' or run the cleanup loop more often. Uploaded inputs are never written to disk (in-memory only), which matches the privacy text.
action_items: Add an exception handler for pdf.ProcessingError that returns 400 (fixes 500s on invalid PDFs/images, encrypted PDFs and the page-limit check)
Validate non-numeric page specs in _parse_pages, organize_pdf and split_pdf: raise ProcessingError instead of letting ValueError become a 500
Check range bounds before expanding them in _parse_pages (DoS); reject reversed ranges in remove-pages
Fix compress_pdf so images are actually replaced (remove the `if False` no-op) and make the levels differ; return the original if the output is larger
Fix ToolRunner addFiles so the oversize error is not cleared
Either wire admin SEO settings into the Seo component or remove the tab
Set explicit CORS_ORIGINS; make the rate limiter/lockout read X-Forwarded-For
Remove the hardcoded admin123 fallback in seed_admin
Mobile menu: show Remove Pages and Organize
firebase.json: decide on Cloud Run vs static; check that 'dist' matches the build dir

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_mycrushpdf_api.py. The 7 current failures are all 500-vs-400 error handling.
